baseline_models.focus_anchor: ضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا ... قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker does not merely request information. He projects a comparison before an audience and voices its conclusion: material disintegration is made to stand as a counterexample to revivification.

activation_trace.role: Rendering and displaying an analogy makes the question a staged representation rather than a neutral request.
The set parable supplies decayed bones as the speaker's test case against revival.
Voiced speech gives the skeptical inference public and contestable form.

changed_reading.before: A person asks who can revive ruined bones.
changed_reading.after: A disputant stages ruined bones as a visible analogy intended to make revival look self-evidently impossible.

baseline_models.mechanism: Forgetting can be active neglect as well as failed recollection. The analogy succeeds only by excluding the speaker's own measured origination from the evidence set.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or neglecting something recasts forgetting as evidentiary omission, whether deliberate or habitual.
Prior measuring and proportioning make his own formation the omitted comparison relevant to his argument.
Origination supplies the event whose power the objection silently brackets.

changed_reading.before: The speaker happens not to remember that he was created.
changed_reading.after: His parable is generated by a selective model: it foregrounds the final ruined state while dropping his own origination from consideration.

baseline_models.mechanism: The hard structural remainder is predicated as worn and fragmented, yet the same root inventory that names decay also carries mending of what has spoiled. The terminal state chosen by the argument therefore contains a latent reversal image.

activation_trace.role: Hard bone supplies the durable bodily structure now presented as having crossed into ruin.
Wearing away, broken remnants, and decayed bones provide the literal terminal-state premise.
Mending a spoiled or scattered thing introduces a root-internal repair vector without denying the surface sense of decay.

changed_reading.before: Ramim marks damage so complete that the bone has no future.
changed_reading.after: Ramim names real disintegration, but its branch field lets the damaged state be read as material upon which repair can operate rather than as a logical endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact parable-making construction previously introduces the surah's commissioned town narrative; in the focus it is taken up by the objector. His act becomes a counter-parable competing over which represented sequence should govern judgment.

activation_trace.role: The focus speaker renders his skeptical representation visible to others.
His ruined-bone case takes the formal shape of a set parable.
The earlier imperative commissions a displayed parable, furnishing the form later appropriated by the objector.
The earlier set parable makes the repeated construction a contest between narrative models.

structural_cues: 36:13 and 36:78 repeat the ordered construction ضرب ... مثلا, but agency shifts from a commanded parable for them to an antagonist's parable for us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact construction and reversed participants; I infer rhetorical appropriation and competition between models. A live alternative is ordinary lexical repetition with no deliberate role reversal.

changed_reading.before: The man offers an isolated skeptical analogy.
changed_reading.after: He counter-programs the surah's own parable form, replacing its sequence of warning and return with a one-frame picture of irreversible decay.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly places an output inside a material state that appears to exclude it: living yield from dead land and ignited fire from green growth. These transitions challenge the focus analogy's assumption that the presently observed state exhausts a material's possible future.

activation_trace.role: Life returning to earth through rain and growth gives the focus verb an ecological transformation image.
Decay supplies the apparently output-excluding material state challenged by the context.
Lifeless earth supplies an inert material substrate rather than merely an abstract death label.
Reviving earth into growth provides an observed-scale analogue for life emerging from apparent lifelessness.
Fresh green vegetation supplies a moist, living-looking state set beside fire.
Kindled fire supplies the apparently contrary output latent in the green-tree example.
Actual ignition turns the material contrast into an operative transition rather than a static resemblance.

structural_cues: 36:33 states dead earth -> revival -> edible grain; 36:80 states green tree -> fire -> human ignition.
Both transition scenes flank the focus and answer a static end-state picture with process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit material transitions; I infer that they train the reader not to treat an observed state as a closed possibility set. The alternative is that they are independent signs of power with no shared material logic.

changed_reading.before: Reviving bones means reversing decay in the same material along an intuitively continuous path.
changed_reading.after: Revival belongs to a broader capacity to elicit outcomes from states judged incompatible with them; decay is one input condition, not a veto.

context_deltas.mechanism: The resurrection sequence renders the dead not as components under slow repair but as occupants stirred from stillness into directed motion. The focus verb thus acquires a summons-and-mobilization dimension alongside biological restoration.

activation_trace.role: The living-being branch anchors revival as restoration of animate agency.
Hard bones are the static remains whose future motion is disputed.
Rapid rushing supplies the kinetic result of revival.
Stirring what was motionless provides the transition from inert rest to activity.
Sleep and stillness recode the grave as a temporary mode of inactivity rather than annihilation.

structural_cues: 36:51 moves directly from the blast to rushing out of graves; 36:52 retrospectively names the prior place as a resting place and the transition as being raised.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stillness, stirring, and rapid movement; I infer a functional sequence in which revival restores directed agency. Literal bodily reconstitution remains a live prerequisite rather than being replaced by this model.

changed_reading.before: The question asks how ruined skeletal matter can be repaired.
changed_reading.after: It also asks who can recall immobilized persons into agency; the surah answers with a compressed rest -> stirring -> rushing sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a drop becomes a manifest disputant; immediately after it, revival is assigned to the one who originated once before. The very capacity by which the man voices his objection is therefore the produced outcome of a transition at least as discontinuous as the one he denies.

activation_trace.role: Neglecting origin names the omission that lets the objection appear coherent.
Origination supplies the causal operation that produced the present speaker.
A minute drop supplies the speaker's materially unpromising initial state.
Adversarial disputation supplies the animate and articulate outcome now arguing against another transformation.
Bringing a thing into being identifies revival with the same originating agency.
The beginning marks a prior successful instance against which the denied act is assessed.
A temporal occurrence frames first creation as one event whose recurrence defeats the claim of categorical impossibility.

structural_cues: 36:77 and 36:79 form an origin-answer frame around the focus: drop -> disputant; decay -> revived by the originator.
The disputant's speech is itself the most immediate evidence of the first transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the drop, the resulting disputant, and the first origination; I infer that the utterance functions as embodied evidence against its own premise. The alternative is a simpler argument from first creation without performative self-refutation.

changed_reading.before: Forgetting creation is a fault mentioned beside the man's argument.
changed_reading.after: The argument performs that forgetting: a product of radical origination uses its produced speech to deny the repeatability of origination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speaker controls likeness rhetorically by setting a parable; 36:81 reassigns likeness to creative production. What he can only picture as an argument, the Creator can measure and instantiate as a renewed like-form.

activation_trace.role: The speaker's likeness is a verbally set parable.
Measured formation supplies the productive counterpart that his verbal model omits.
The threefold creation occurrence saturates the answer with measured production rather than mere description.
Likeness and counterpart turn mathal from the man's rhetorical object into something creatable.
Effective capacity joins likeness to actual production.

structural_cues: مَثَلًا in 36:78 returns as مِثْلَهُم in 36:81 amid three خ ل ق forms and explicit capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and creation cluster; I infer a shift from rhetorical modeling to material instantiation. A live alternative reads مثلهم only as replacement counterparts, not recreated identity.

changed_reading.before: The man's analogy fixes the terms on which bones and revival are compared.
changed_reading.after: The answer takes control of the analogy category itself: likeness is not only said but can be measured into renewed form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gives human saying a descriptive and adversarial function; 36:82 joins saying to command and immediate occurrence. The issue shifts from whether language can imagine a path from decay to life to whether efficacious command is constrained by that imagination.

activation_trace.role: The man's voiced question asserts a skeptical representation of what can occur.
Command and imposition supply the directive force absent from the man's descriptive speech.
Voiced saying is reused as the hinge between willing and occurrence.
Occurrence and temporal presence supply the realized result of the command.

structural_cues: 36:78 has قال من يحيي; 36:82 answers with يقول له كن فيكون, repeating speech while changing its causal status.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel saying constructions and the command-to-occurrence sequence; I infer a contrast between representational and efficacious speech. The alternative is that saying simply reports effortless power without establishing a distinct speech mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The man's spoken question sets the conceptual limit of the problem.
changed_reading.after: His speech only describes a limit; the closing speech act produces the state his description cannot model.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because records and testimony concern accountable deeds, not an explicit recipe for rebuilding matter. It remains anchored in the focus's fragmented bones and the surah's preserved traces and speaking limbs. Downstream prose should call it an informational or forensic analogy, not claim that the packet equates bodily particles with a written archive.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ as bodily remainder whose decay is assumed to erase recoverable identity

activation_trace.role: Scattered dust and fragments supply the apparently information-poor remainder.
Writing supplies durable inscription of what would otherwise pass away.
A remaining mark that indicates what was supplies continuity through absence.
Exhaustive enumeration prevents traces from collapsing into undifferentiated loss.
A secured seal displaces control from the speaker's mouth.
Intelligible bodily speech turns matter into an active bearer of retained evidence.
A witnessing sign supplies recoverable identity and history through the body.

changed_reading.before: Once bone becomes fragments, the person has been materially erased.
changed_reading.after: Decay can be imagined as loss of visible organization without loss of recoverable trace: the surah's bodies and records retain enough distinction to answer for a person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on distant ر م م branches of silence and unarticulated mouth movement, so it is a root-network echo rather than the lexical sense of رميم in 36:78. It remains anchored in قال, رميم, and the later sealing of mouths while limbs speak. Render only as an ironic speech reversal, never as a translation of رميم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ ... رَمِيمٌ: the objector's speaking mouth assigns final muteness to the bones

activation_trace.role: The objector's audible speech claims interpretive authority over the mute remains.
The distant silence branch supplies an ironic root-level echo around the supposedly speechless object.
Mouth movement short of articulated speech sharpens the contrast between voiced claim and displaced testimony.
The secured seal removes the mouth's ability to control the account.
Intelligible speech transfers from mouth to bodily members.

changed_reading.before: The living mouth speaks about bones that can no longer answer.
changed_reading.after: The surah can invert that hierarchy: the challenging mouth is silenced, while the body it treated as mute becomes the speaking witness.

strongest_changes: The repeated ضرب ... مثلا construction turns the focus analogy into a counter-parable competing with the surah's earlier commissioned parable.
The drop-to-disputant sequence makes the man's own act of speaking embodied evidence for the originating power he neglects.
Dead earth producing grain and green growth producing fire replace a static decay premise with a grammar of material transition.
The closing echoes shift likeness from verbal representation to producible form and saying from description to efficacious command.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did more than accumulate proofs of resurrection: it reassigned the focus's own instruments. Parable, likeness, and speech first serve the objection, then return as narrative competition, creatable form, and command that produces occurrence.
remaining_uncertainties: The repair branch of ر م م is a live root-level counterimage, but how much it shades the surface predicate رميم remains uncertain.
The retained-trace model may illuminate personal continuity, yet the record and bodily testimony can remain strictly moral evidence rather than a material mechanism.
مِثْلَهُم in 36:81 can support renewed like-form, replacement counterparts, or both; the trace does not disambiguate them.
The mobilization model describes resurrection's functional result but does not independently specify the material process by which bones are reconstituted.
